title: Remedies for breach
summary: Remedies determine what relief follows a breach: compensation, restoration of benefits, an order to perform, or another legally authorized response.
notes: Begin with the protected interest and the kind of relief requested. Then apply the relevant limits, including adequacy of damages, avoided loss, foreseeability, certainty, and agreed remedies. The case index separates the different remedial questions and retains each case’s procedural result.

textbookImport.basis: Plain-language synthesis of the cited casebook passages; subject to the jurisdictional and source limits stated there.
